key_concepts: Scientific investigation includes aim/problem, materials and equipment, method/procedures,
Scientists develop ideas like the particle model through observation and experimentation
A scientific problem can be identified from curiosity or unexpected observations
A hypothesis is a testable proposed explanation or prediction
Primary data collection uses direct observation or experimentation; secondary data uses ex
Quantitative data are numerical measurements; qualitative data are descriptive observation
Data should be recorded immediately and accurately to prevent loss and ensure accuracy
Data tables organize information in rows and columns
Controlled experiments change one variable while keeping others constant
Conclusions are based on collected results or data
